description: Reads what happened to the Live app's transactional email over the last `days` (1–90, default 30), per template (sign-in, purchase, plan-start, notify, inbox-reply, new-sign-in): sent, bounced, complained (marked as spam) and deferred (the receiving server asked to try later). Counts only — never an address or a message. live:read; audited; changes nothing. This is what a founder may call whether the app's emails arrived.
name: live_emails
title: Live: email delivery
